The elimination of ornidazole is reported to be largely unaltered in patients with im- paired renal function (see under Pharmacokinetics, above). Dos- age adjustment is therefore usually unnecessary, although pa- tients receiving haemodialysis should be given a supplemental dose of ornidazole before dialysis; a supplemental dose of 500 mg should be given if the daily dose is 2 g daily or 250 mg should be given if the daily dose is 1 g daily.
